V6hm_vs_V6h.runs_if: always (pre-registered); it decides only if V6h is adopted

rules.adopt: Y over X iff the hval interval of mean(Y) - mean(X) lies below 0, every seed pair's hval point difference is below 0, and neither the dev VN nor the dev manga interval lies above 0 (eval/vocr6_protocol.json decision.adopt, with manga as a second guard)
rules.manga: V6hm over V6h iff the dev manga interval of mean(V6hm) - mean(V6h) lies below 0 and neither the hval nor the dev VN interval lies above 0; otherwise no Manga109 material is in a shipped model
rules.fold: the fold-in run ships iff neither its dev VN nor its dev manga interval against its seed-1 sibling lies above 0 (one pair)
rules.ship: the shipped arm is V6hm if V6h is adopted and V6hm is adopted over it, else V6h if adopted, else nothing; its fold-in run ships if it passes 'fold', else its seed-1 run (trained without hval)

estimates: unchanged from VOCR5-V (same shape): est. 66 / 50 ms per median VN column and 140 / 106 ms per median VN region at 333 / 444 MHz on one A9 core (docs/vertical.md); nothing has run on a console
